findings.claim: Declared: `world.daemon`'s `match` “reads only the processes its start made.” Practiced: `new` is every host-visible PID whose start time differs from the pre-start table, and `matching(match, new)` treats every concurrently created matching process as owned. A process launched concurrently outside the World is recorded and killed by close.

Declared: a process started through `world.daemon(...)` is “recorded, as malloc records a block for free,” including daemons identified by `match` because they do not carry the World's HOME. Practiced: `run(..., expect=0)` raises before process discovery and registration when the start command returns nonzero. A partially successful start can therefore leave a matching, non-HOME daemon alive; close's fallback sweep only examines processes carrying HOME and returns clean.

Declared: close “finishes its cleanup either way and then raises `DaemonRefused`.” Practiced: `_run_stop` catches only `Timeout` and `PlantFailed` around a stop argv. A normal `PermissionError` from `subprocess.Popen` escapes the close loop; because the remaining cleanup is in that same `finally` body and `closed` is already true, escalation, sweeping, environment restoration, root removal, and every subsequent close are bypassed.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import contextlib,os,shutil,signal,sys,uuid
from ops.testkit import World
token='a528-stop-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
starter="import subprocess,sys;subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import time;time.sleep(30)',sys.argv[1]],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)"
w=World(host_path=False);d=w.daemon('bad-stop',[sys.executable,'-c',starter,token],['/'],match=(token,),timeout=.05)
try:
 w.close()
except PermissionError:
 assert d.alive() and w.root.exists();print('FAIL stop spawn error escaped; daemon and root survived')
finally:
 for pid in d.alive():
  with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
 shutil.rmtree(w.root,ignore_errors=True)
PY

findings.claim: Declared: credentials must not enter a record or log, and docs/tests.md:60 says a refusal names argv size “never its bytes.” Practiced: daemon startup uses `run(..., expect=0)`, whose failure text interpolates the complete argv plus stdout and stderr; the daemon/adopt not-found paths also interpolate raw `match` tokens. An ordinary failed start therefore copies a credential-bearing argv into the exception surfaced by the test runner.

except PlantFailed as exc:

finally:w.close()

findings.claim: Declared: the refusal wire is “One line per refusal,” and daemon close emits “one line per daemon.” Practiced: `_check_daemon` accepts every nonempty string as a daemon name and `stop_daemon` inserts it unescaped into both the expected and needed fields. A newline-bearing name injects additional forged refusal lines into stderr.

envelope.note: reused: lane MCP lane_brief, lane_jobs, lane_changes, lane_findings; coordination record A-528; testkit.world and testkit.daemon contracts; Graft repo map. Read all required docs, the complete supplied diff, the prior six findings and dispositions, all changed implementation/tests/fixtures/probe rows, and the added dispatch record; in/ was empty. Looked at argv/shell seams (structured argv, no shell; one disclosure finding), SQL (absent), template/refusal seams (one injection finding), secrets/records/logs (no credential bytes found in the tree record; one runtime disclosure finding), path/process confinement (two P1 findings), timeout/cleanup (callable fix verified; one P1 exception-path finding), permission/sandbox claims (the record says workspace-write and its argv requests workspace-write), vendor output (/proc start times checked), and supply chain (no dependency, pin, lockfile, or fetched-action change). The changed unittest module starts no tmux server and was attempted, but this worker sandbox denied AF_UNIX bind; the long dispatch TMPDIR also exceeds the fixture's 100-byte socket limit, so socket-holder behavior could not be executed here. Static reading confirms adopt rejects sockets resolving outside the World. The residual start-time-check-to-os.kill PID-reuse race could not be practically reproduced. The previously ruled scrubbed-HOME descendant gap was not re-raised; finding 2 is distinct because match explicitly supports a non-HOME daemon but registration never runs after a failed start. 🌱 graft saved ~1,679,239 tokens this turn.
